definitions.gloss: tugboat; a boat that tows or pushes larger vessels
definitions.explanation: A small, powerful boat used to tow or push ships that are too large or disabled to maneuver on their own, especially in and out of harbors.

examples.japanese: {曳航|えいこう}{船|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
{大型船|おおがたせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曳航|えいこう}{船|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: A tugboat pulls the large ship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故障|こしょう}した→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{曳航|えいこう}{船|せん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: The disabled ship was towed back to port by a tugboat.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{曳航|えいこう}→曳航：26451_eikou⟧ (towing) + ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧ (boat). A small, powerful vessel that tows or pushes larger ships, especially when guiding them through harbors or rescuing disabled craft.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {曳航|えいこう}{船|せん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to tow with a tugboat
- {曳航|えいこう}{船|せん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{曳|ひ}かれる: to be towed by a tugboat

In everyday speech it is often called タグボート.
